about: Which shared rule sets apply to this manuscript, its own rules, and its parameters. Shared sets live in conventions/sets/. A set only applies if listed under "use". level "as-written" keeps each rule's fix/check level; "check-only" turns every rule into a check (use this for a set newly adopted from another manuscript until it is confirmed here). "promote" lists rule ids to treat as fix anyway; "disable" switches rules off.

ƀ before a sum (followed by ß or 𝒹) is probably a misreading of ℔. Elsewhere ƀ = braccia (inventories) or -br- (month names): keep it.
